segments.text_en: And in this we will add whole spices, one cinnamon stick, one big cardamom, one clove flower, one flower of javitri (badian), and a one-inch piece of nutmeg, six black peppercorns, so all these things we will crush into the water. Now,

segments.text_en: So let's see, now we will prepare the marinade spices. We have taken 200 grams of yogurt and beaten it well. We will add one tablespoon Kashmiri red chili powder, one teaspoon garam masala powder, and one tablespoon of something (likely salt or another ingredient) to this.

segments.text_en: So our marinade spice mix is ready now. Let's take the chicken; we have taken a kilo of chicken here which has been washed well. We will add the marinade spices made earlier and one teaspoon of salt to it. Salt you can adjust according to your taste.

segments.text_en: So all these things we will put into the mixer jar and prepare a fine powder from them. See here, we have prepared this powder. Let's check the rice now; see the rice is cooked up to 80% here.

segments.text_en: We have separated the rice from water now. We will take a base for making biryani here so we will put 200 grams of oil which needs to be heated very well. We have cut two big-sized onions finely and need to fry them until golden brown because when we add the piriyani layer, this will come in handy.

segments.text: क्योंकि जब हम पिरियानी की लेयर लगाएंगे उस बक्त ये काम आएगा हमने जो चिकन मैरिनेट करने के लिए रखा हुआ था आदा घंटे के लिए वो एट कर देंगे और 10 मिनट अच्छे से हमें इसको कुक कर लेना है पानी बगरा एड़ नहीं करना है जो दही का पानी र

So it will be cooked up to 50%, and when we steam it later, it will be fully done. We have added two tablespoons of adrak (ginger) lasan (garlic), and we will add the coriander, fennel, and cumin powder that we prepared earlier, and the aromatic biryani spice mix.

segments.text: 2-3 पिंच हमने फूट कलर लिया है, ओरेंज फूट कलर, 1 टेबल स्पून केबरा बॉटर्स के साथ हम इसको मेक्स कर लेंगे, और जो हमने चावल के लेयर लगाई है, उस पर ये कलर डाल देंगे, और जो हमने ओयल बचा कर रखा हुआ था, आदा जो प्याज ब्राउन किये �

segments.text: अब हमें जो गोल्डन प्याज फ्राई करके रखे हुए थे वो ऐड कर देंगे अगर आप ना करना चाहें तो स्किप भी कर सकते हैं अब इसको दम लगा देना है हमें 15 मिनट के लिए तो हम पहले 1 मिनट हाई फ्लेम पर ऐसे ही इसको कोक करेंगे अब हमने 1 मिनट हो चुका है
segments.text_en: Now we will add the golden fried onions that were prepared earlier; if you don't want to, you can skip it. Now we need to steam this for 15 minutes so first, we will cook it on high flame for 1 minute. We have now completed 1 minute.
